```{r packages}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(slider)
```

```{r functions}
#| include: false
import <- function(txt) {
  header <- txt |> 
    read_lines(n_max = 1) |> 
    str_split_1(",")|> 
    str_remove("\\(.*\\)")
  solves <- txt |>
    read_delim(
      delim = ";",
      skip = 1,
      col_names = header,
      col_types = "ffidcfc"
    ) |> 
    mutate(
      Date = as_datetime(Date / 1000, tz = "America/Toronto"),
      Time = Time |> replace_when(Penalty == 2 ~ NA)
    )
}

round_five_up <- function(n) {
  if (is.na(n)) {
    n
  } else if (n %% 10 == 5) { # (remainder) is the ones place a 5
    (n %/% 10 + 1) * 10 # (quotient) manually adding 1 to round up
  } else {
    round(n, -1)
  }
}

.ao <- function(times) {
  DNFs <- sum(is.na(times))
  if (DNFs > 1) {
    return(NA)
  } else if (DNFs == 1) {
    mean(
      times[-which.min(times)], 
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    mean(
      times[-c(which.min(times), which.max(times))]
    )
  }
}

ao5 <- function(data) {
  data |> 
    mutate(
      ao5 = Solve_Time |> 
        slide_dbl(.ao, .before = 4, .complete = TRUE) |> 
        round(-1) |> as.integer()
    )
}

ao12 <- function(data) {
  data |> 
    mutate(
      ao12 = Solve_Time |> 
        slide_dbl(.ao, .before = 11, .complete = TRUE) |> 
        map_int(round_five_up)
    )
}

.ao100 <- function(times) {
  NAs <- is.na(times)
  DNFs <- sum(NAs)
  if (DNFs > 5) {
    return(NA)
  } else if (DNFs > 0) {
    times[NAs] <- Inf 
  }
  times[-c(kit::topn(times, 5, decreasing = FALSE), kit::topn(times, 5))] |>
      sum() / 90
}

ao100 <- function(data) {
  data |> 
    mutate(
      ao100 = Solve_Time |> 
        slide_dbl(.ao100, .before = 99, .complete = TRUE) |> 
        map_int(round_five_up)
    )
}

.ao1000 <- function(times) {
  NAs <- is.na(times)
  DNFs <- sum(NAs)
  if (DNFs > 50) {
    return(NA)
  } else if (DNFs > 0) {
    times[NAs] <- Inf 
  }
  times[-c(kit::topn(times, 50, decreasing = FALSE), kit::topn(times, 50))] |>
    sum() / 900
}

ao1000 <- function(data) {
  data |> 
    mutate(
      ao1000 = Solve_Time |> 
        slide_dbl(.ao1000, .before = 999, .complete = TRUE) |> 
        map_int(round_five_up)
    )
}
```

```{r data}
#| include: false
solves_ <- import(".data/Backup_2026-11-12_17-12.txt")

solves <- solves_ |>
  filter(Puzzle == "333", Category == "main") |> 
  select(-c(Puzzle, Category, Comment)) |> 
  rename("Solve_Time" = "Time") |> 
  rowid_to_column("Solve_Number")

solves <- solves |> 
  ao5() |>
  ao12() |> 
  ao100() |> 
  ao1000()
```

```{r personal-bests}
PBs <- c("Solve_Time", "ao5", "ao12", "ao100", "ao1000") |> 
  map(\(field) {
    solves |> 
      slice_min(.data[[field]], with_ties = FALSE) |> 
      mutate(Type = field) |> 
      rename(Time = all_of(field)) |> 
      select(Type, Time, Date)
  }) |>
  list_rbind() |> 
  mutate(
    Type = Type |> replace_when(Type == "Solve_Time" ~ "single"),
    Time = Time / 1000,
    Date = date(Date)
  )

PBs |>
  knitr::kable(align = "ccc")
```

```{r plot-1}
times_up_to_60 <- solves |> 
  select(Solve_Time) |> 
  drop_na() |> 
  mutate(Solve_Time = floor(Solve_Time / 1000)) |> 
  count(Solve_Time) |>
  filter_out(Solve_Time > 60)

times_up_to_60 |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = Solve_Time, y = n, fill = n, label = Solve_Time)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(vjust = -0.5, size = 2.5) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(200, 1000, 200)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = "none") +
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Count") +
  theme_classic()
```
